questions.q: How many sharps are in the key signature of D major?
questions.why: D major has F sharp and C sharp.

questions.q: Which scale is the natural minor with the 7th note raised?
questions.why: The harmonic minor raises the 7th by a semitone.

questions.q: What is the interval from C up to G?
questions.why: C to G is five letter names and 7 semitones: a perfect 5th.

questions.q: What is a sequence in a melody?
questions.model: A short melodic idea repeated at a higher or lower pitch.
